human_instructions_incorporated.summary: Keep the stylist on the right and reserve the left for website copy.

creative_thesis.thesis_statement: The stylist is not displayed beside fashion imagery; she is shown as the intelligence actively shaping an editorial world around her clients.
creative_thesis.communication_problem: Communicate premium styling authority in a 16:9 hero with fixed right-subject and left-copy requirements.
creative_thesis.creative_answer: Build a functional editorial environment that crosses depth planes around the stylist while controlled negative space extends the same world into the copy field.
creative_thesis.desired_viewer_perception: This is a distinctive fashion authority with a point of view, not a portrait inserted into a luxury template.
creative_thesis.rationale: Editorial integration proves taste more convincingly than purple gradients, fashion icons or decorative props.

commercial_psychology.rationale: The hero must sell expert transformation through visible editorial judgment.

narrative_tension.central_tension: Personal authority versus an evolving editorial world.
narrative_tension.subject_role: The orchestrator of taste and transformation.
narrative_tension.environment_role: Evidence of her eye, built from selective fashion textures, structure and depth.
narrative_tension.relationship: The environment appears authored by and responsive to the stylist.
narrative_progression: Read her authority through the integrated editorial world
narrative_tension.rationale: The environment functions as professional evidence rather than niche decoration.

subject_strategy.presence: Strong right-side subject with room to breathe
subject_strategy.relationship_to_environment: Partially crossed by editorial layers and connected through material continuity
identity_requirements: Avoid beauty retouching that erases character

emotional_strategy.rationale: Premium fashion should feel deliberate, not loud.

visual_hierarchy.reason: The service is anchored in personal authority.
The left field converts authority into an offer.
Demonstrates taste and integrates the composition.
visual_hierarchy.relationship_to_previous: Bridges subject and copy without filling all negative space.

creative_concept.visual_world: A restrained fashion editorial space where selective material layers reveal the stylist's authorship.
creative_concept.narrative_function: Make taste visible as an organizing force.
creative_concept.composition_logic: Functional asymmetry: subject authority on the right, intentional copy field on the left, connected by directional editorial structure.
creative_concept.depth_logic: Concentrated layering near the subject thins into usable negative space.
creative_concept.environment_logic: Fashion cues appear through material, rhythm and framing, never cheap iconography.
creative_concept.typography_role: Copy is a primary compositional mass and part of the editorial system, not an overlay added afterward.

candidates.concept_summary: The stylist authors an integrated editorial environment that opens into copy space.
candidates.core_mechanism: Detail gradient from dense subject field to controlled negative space
risks: Too much restraint can feel empty
candidates.decision_reason: It turns the fixed layout into a meaningful editorial system.

candidates.concept_summary: Portrait on a purple gradient with gold accents.
candidates.decision_reason: Premium would be asserted through styling clichés instead of demonstrated judgment.

candidates.concept_summary: Fill the hero with clothing racks, shoes and accessories.
candidates.decision_reason: Objects identify the niche but do not communicate the stylist's authority.

ideation.convergence_summary: The selected concept keeps niche specificity through editorial mechanisms rather than literal fashion inventory.

selected_direction.name: The Editorial Eye
selected_direction.concept: The stylist's discernment organizes a layered editorial world that deliberately resolves into left-side copy space.
selected_direction.why_it_won: It satisfies the hard layout while making asymmetry, integration and negative space serve the business message.
selected_direction.core_visual_idea: A gradient of editorial detail shaped by the stylist's presence.
selected_direction.creative_risk: The environment may become either decorative clutter or an empty gradient.
selected_direction.originality_strategy: Use fashion's visual grammar—rhythm, material tension and selective detail—without stock icons or a template palette.

visual_mechanisms.name: CONCENTRATED_DETAIL_GRADIENT
visual_mechanisms.function: Concentrate editorial information near the stylist and release it toward copy.
visual_mechanisms.target_effect: Functional asymmetry and intelligent negative space
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Makes the required right/left split feel authored rather than imposed.

visual_mechanisms.name: EDITORIAL_LAYER_INTERLOCK
visual_mechanisms.function: Cross selected material and framing layers around the subject.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Avoids portrait pasted on background while keeping the face clear.

visual_mechanisms.name: CONTROLLED_NEGATIVE_SPACE
visual_mechanisms.function: Protect copy legibility without disconnecting the left field.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Copy space is a hard requirement and must remain part of the same world.

queries: editorial asymmetry with functional copy space

retrieved_mechanisms.why_relevant: Supports copy without flattening the environment.
retrieved_mechanisms.how_adapted: Negative space retains faint editorial continuity rather than becoming a blank gradient.

adaptation_notes: VKB informed the mechanism; the Creative Director chose its role in the concept.

evidence.approved_pattern: Across approved website heroes, subject/environment integration was achieved through layered depth rather than flat portrait-on-gradient composition.
evidence.relevance_to_current_problem: The stylist hero also risks becoming a separated portrait and copy template.
evidence.how_it_influenced_direction: Required editorial layers to interact with the subject while preserving facial clarity.

protected_elements.reason: The service depends on personal authority.

creative_constraints.statement: Subject remains on the right and the left remains viable for copy.
The subject must share depth and material relationships with the environment.

banned_tropes.name: PORTRAIT_ON_PURPLE_GRADIENT
banned_tropes.description: Isolated portrait over a luxury-coded purple gradient.
banned_tropes.reason: Template language with no professional narrative.

banned_tropes.name: CHEAP_FASHION_ICONOGRAPHY
banned_tropes.description: Random hangers, shoes or makeup objects used as niche proof.

frozen_decisions.decision: Right-side stylist and left-side copy field.
Editorial detail concentrates near the subject and releases toward copy.

strong_guidelines.decision: Layering must integrate the subject without obscuring identity.
strong_guidelines.rationale: Art direction and recognition are both required.

open_decisions.decision: Exact material motifs, lighting behavior and typography implementation.
open_decisions.rationale: Technical choices must realize, not redefine, the editorial system.

confidence.rationale: The selected system turns every hard layout requirement into a narrative and hierarchy decision.

approval.notes: Approved for technical exploration, not claimed as human approval.

technical_handoff.creative_goal: Present the stylist as the author of an integrated premium editorial world.
technical_handoff.selected_direction_summary: Right-side stylist anchors a concentrated editorial field that releases into functional left copy space.
known_risks: Copy space may disconnect from the environment
